decisions.capability: Render the configured HUD in a native Claude terminal
decisions.evidence_scope: The retained foundation-closure native PTY observations show configured claude-hud 0.8.0 in Claude 2.1.278 before and after a bounded review, including model, project, context and usage fields. This catalog reconciliation reuses those observations without a new terminal or model run. Earlier onboarding and effort-overlay attempts remain retained.
limitations: Evidence for the visible statusline is the original coordinator's screen observations and independent installed-plugin audit, separate from the native context export.
Not every HUD statistic, exact billing reconciliation, Windows Terminal dropdown interaction, automatic compaction or new-host activation was qualified.
decisions.next_gap: Verify target-host activation or a specific untested statistic only when that capability is needed; reuse the accepted recorded rendering scope.

existing_overturn_when: A required trace, evaluation or supported model/hardware workload is unanswerable by the current path, and one alternative passes privacy, fidelity, latency/cost and recovery comparisons without duplicate capture.
limitations: Source time differs from scrape time; usage differs from savings. The current interactive HUD evidence does not certify every statistic or automatic compaction.
Local generation and gateway acceptance are route/workload-specific; catalog presence is not a passed exact-model task.
requirement: Observe real native usage/service outcomes through one privacy-filtered local pipeline and qualify any optional model route on its actual workload.
rules: Judge from retained evidence. Open the evidence_refs of every adopted candidate (bounded: the referenced file or its relevant section) and record every path you opened in sources_read. Do not rely on memory of the repositories.

The winner set is 1-3 adopted candidates (adopted == true) that best satisfy the requirement on the evidence. why_selected must cite at least one evidence path and state what was actually observed (native execution, measured comparison, local integration, synthetic fixture or source review), not what the project claims.
Every adopted non-winner candidate appears in alternatives with a why_not_default that states the concrete evidence gap or trade-off; add non-adopted candidates only with the same standard.

If a non-adopted candidate would satisfy the requirement better on the evidence, do not select it: record it in challenger_preferred with the comparison (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path, or a python3/node command) that would establish it. Agreement between lanes never promotes; only an executed comparison can.

overturn_when names the concrete check that would change the verdict (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path or a runnable python3/node command). open_gaps lists what the evidence does not establish. limits lists what you could not read or verify. Do not invent paths, numbers or results; leave evidence_refs empty rather than guess.
